# Forms inside Commands

Each Command here has a form of its own, inside it, with no Submit.

`create_repo` needs an organization, which has no default, so it waits for one.

<Command
  id="create_repo"
  env={{ ORG: "{{ .inputs.GithubOrgName }}", REPO: "{{ .inputs.RepoName }}" }}
  outputs={["repo"]}
  command={`echo "repo=$ORG/$REPO" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
>
<Inputs id="repo_inputs">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: GithubOrgName
    type: string
    description: GitHub organization or username
    validations:
      - required
  - name: RepoName
    type: string
    description: Repository name
    default: my-next-app
    validations:
      - required
```
</Inputs>
</Command>

`scaffold` runs with its choices' defaults.

<Command
  id="scaffold"
  env={{
    LANGUAGE: "{{ .inputs.Language }}",
    TAILWIND: "{{ .inputs.UseTailwind }}",
    BUNDLER: "{{ .inputs.Bundler }}",
    ALIAS: "{{ .inputs.ImportAlias }}",
  }}
  outputs={["options"]}
  command={`echo "options=$LANGUAGE $TAILWIND $BUNDLER $ALIAS" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
>
<Inputs id="scaffold_options">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: Language
    type: enum
    description: Programming language
    options: [TypeScript, JavaScript]
    default: TypeScript
  - name: UseTailwind
    type: enum
    description: Include Tailwind CSS for styling
    options: ["Yes", "No"]
    default: "Yes"
  - name: Bundler
    type: enum
    description: Development bundler
    options: [Turbopack, Webpack]
    default: Turbopack
  - name: ImportAlias
    type: string
    description: Import alias for the project
    default: "@/*"
```
</Inputs>
</Command>
